description: Use this when you are about to write for the user's brand and need its voice, niche, audience and offer, or the user asks what XcutAI knows about their brand. Returns the canvas's brand profile and saved memory facts with ids. Free. Do not use for public creators the user does not own (use xcut_find_outliers or xcut_search_viral).

canvas_id.description: Canvas id (a UUID) from xcut_list_canvases. The brand attached to this canvas is returned.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id
